description: identity.rs handle_identity_changes response does not include updatedProperties. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires updatedProperties in every /changes response. Mailbox/changes and all chat-server /changes handlers include it. Thread/changes also omits it — two handlers share this bug. Pattern: every new /changes handler added to the codebase risks silently omitting this field because the generic handle_changes in jmap-server includes it but domain-specific handlers do not reuse it.
title: Identity/changes missing updatedProperties field
